BOXSV / INTERNAL COLLECTION REVIEW

201 designs. No final approvals.

195 countries, five oceans and Moon; one-of-one each, equal edition scarcity. These are unchanged inner collectible candidates, not outer custody vaults or minted tokens. Promotional illustrations differ from actual models. No artwork changed in the eight reviewed batches or this consolidation: no fabricated before/after improvements.

73 user/package decision holds; 128 candidates with limitations. All final art, rights, storage and release approvals remain held. USA v9 star-to-body continuation is unresolved. Historical exact-byte archive holds: Iceland, Morocco, Rwanda; unchecked full inner inventories: Iceland, Morocco, Namibia, New Zealand, Paraguay.

Standalone comparison overview only. Interactive models are in the separately delivered full local archive; this file has no missing viewer links.
